name: bison-fund-investment-analysis
description: Guide equity-pitch research with Socratic gates and sources.

interface.shortDescription: Equity-pitch research with Socratic gates and a source on every number
interface.longDescription: Runs an equity pitch as a gated loop: the analyst states a view before the assistant researches, every figure carries a source and an as-of date, and the price target, thesis pillars, and buy/hold/sell call stay with the analyst. Ships the DCF script, the NDSU Bison Fund deck system, and the commentable review harness.
